facts.advisory_summary:
Symfony's incorrect parsing of PATH_INFO can lead to limited authorization bypass — ### Description

The `Request` class improperly interprets some `PATH_INFO` in a way that leads to representing some URLs with a path that doesn't start with a `/`. This can allow bypassing some access control rules that are built with this `/`-prefix assumption.

### Resolution

The `Request` class now ensures that URL paths always start with a `/`.

The patch for this issue is available [here](https://github.com/symfony/symfony/commit/9962b91b12bb791322fa73836b350836b6db7cac) for branch 5.4.

### Credits

We

expect.note: Every web request builds a Symfony Request; Request::preparePathInfo (http-foundation 7.2.6 Request.php:1880-1904) returns substr after baseUrl without forcing a leading '/', on attacker-controlled REQUEST_URI. BookStack/Laravel routing uses route middleware rather than '/'-prefix rules, so impact is limited, but the vulnerable code runs on attacker input.
expect.labelled_by: claude-opus code read 2026-11-05 (blind to judge verdicts; agent-labelled; php1)

Symfony has Email Header / SMTP Command Injection via CRLF in Symfony\Component\Mime\Address — ### Description

`Symfony\Component\Mime\Address` is the value-object every Symfony Mailer address (to/cc/bcc/from/reply-to) flows through; its constructor is documented as validating the address and throwing on invalid input, so developers treat it as a security boundary.

The constructor accepts email addresses whose local-part (the part before `@`) is an RFC-5322 *quoted string* containing raw `\r\n` bytes, e.g. `"x\r\nBcc: attacker@evil"@example.com`. The stored address is later emitted verbatim

expect.note: Email (default MAIL_DRIVER smtp) is sent via ssddanbrown/symfony-mailer -> symfony/mime Address. Attacker-supplied addresses: self-registration email validated only by Laravel 'email' (RFC) rule (app/Access/Controllers/RegisterController.php:77) then confirmation mail sent to it; also users created/edited by users-manage holders (app/Users/Controllers/UserController.php:85,148) receive invites. Quoted local-part with CRLF passes RFC validation per advisory (symfony/mime Address.php:53).
expect.labelled_by: claude-opus code read 2026-11-05 (blind to judge verdicts; agent-labelled; php1)
expect.requires: registration-enabled (admin setting, default false app/Config/setting-defaults.php:34) or users-manage permission
